errors.prefix:
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6541882Z error[vulnerability]: Degraded secret zeroization capabilities
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6542096Z      ┌─ /github/workspace/codex-rs/Cargo.lock:1232:1
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6542205Z      │
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6542612Z 1232 │ vodozemac 0.10.0 registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6543104Z      │ ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ security vulnerability detected
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6543216Z      │
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6543365Z      ├ ID: RUSTSEC-2026-0451
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6543619Z      ├ Advisory: https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0451
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6543913Z      ├ In version 0.11.1 and earlier of vodozemac, the Olm root key ratchet did not
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6544142Z        zeroize its HKDF output after use. Each ratchet step left a copy of the new root
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6544251Z        key and chain key in freed heap memory.
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6544333Z        
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6544410Z        ## Impact
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6544492Z        
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6544706Z        An attacker who can read the process's memory, for example through a separate
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6544923Z        memory-disclosure bug, a core dump, or swapped-out pages, may recover root keys
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6545136Z        and chain keys from earlier ratchet steps. A leaked chain key allows decrypting
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6545363Z        the messages in that chain, weakening Olm's forward secrecy for affected
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6545447Z        sessions.
2026-11-10T06:48:23.6545708Z
